_readme: Per-edge accessibility attributes layered on top of campus_walk.json (OSM). Keys are edge ids from that file ('<node>-<node>'). Fields: has_steps (bool), steps_verified (bool), slope_pct (number), shade (bool), source ('surveyed' | 'simulated'). Edges not listed keep OSM data: source 'imported', attributes unknown. Replace 'simulated' entries with 'surveyed' ones after the walk survey. Report-based barriers (e.g. the demo steps, seed report r-001) live in reports, not here, so resolving a report changes the route.
